sql.if: and exists ( select 1 from sporadic_contract sc where sc.sp_id = mn.id and sc.mf_code like CONCAT('%', #{params.mfCode}, '%') )

AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sporadic_payments_dtl spd JOIN sporadic_settlement_dtl ssd ON ssd.se_id = spd.sp_d_id JOIN Maintenance_Record mr ON mr.mr_Id = ssd.mr_id WHERE spd.sp_p_did = mn.id AND mr.mr_Category != #{params.mrCategory} ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sporadic_payments_dtl spd JOIN sporadic_settlement_dtl ssd ON ssd.se_id = spd.sp_d_id JOIN Maintenance_Record mr ON mr.mr_Id = ssd.mr_id WHERE spd.sp_p_did = mn.id AND mr.mr_Category = #{params.mrCategory} )

mapper.select:

#{id}
mapper.sql: LISTAGG(mf.mf_code, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY mf.mf_code) AS mf_codes
GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT mf.mf_code ORDER BY mf.mf_code) AS mf_codes
mapper.select: select DISTINCT mr.* from sporadic_payments mn left join sporadic_payments_dtl spd on spd.sp_p_did=mn.id left join sporadic_settlement ss on ss.id=spd.sp_d_id left join sporadic_settlement_dtl ssd on ssd.se_id=ss.id left join maintenance_record mr on mr.mr_Id=ssd.mr_id where mn.id=#{id}
